pricing_basis: Registered local tariff; verify before any future paid authorization.
acceptance: Human-adjudicated source/target labels before unblinding; never use model agreement as gold.
At least 10/12 natural context sets useful, no cross-mod/plugin evidence or contradiction silently accepted.
Detect all four controlled errors and introduce zero critical/major errors in at most four edits.
No false semantic alarms on human-accepted controls; measure paired human corrections and review time.
Report outcomes separately for natural cases and synthetic probes; this sample cannot calibrate autoapproval.
stop_conditions: Any unexpected request/tool/model, production write or budget above the sealed bounds.
Any unknown usage or critical identity/markup failure; preserve receipts, never automatic resend.
More than 10% malformed/refused/incomplete outputs; terminate the experiment and adjudicate.
pending: Explicit future API authorization, verified tariff, safe execution adapter and independent human labels.
judge_independence: Blind separate invocation; same model family may share errors.
